name: christianpure-bible-places
title: Places in the Bible, with their names in 11 languages
description: Every place the Bible names that can be put on a map, from Genesis to Revelation: its location, how sure that location is, the verses that name it, and its name as the Bible in each of 11 languages prints it. Built on the OpenBible.info Bible Geocoding Data (CC BY 4.0) for the map at https://christianpure.com/bible-places-map/. CC BY 4.0: credit OpenBible.info and Christian Pure.

sources.title: Pleiades gazetteer of ancient places (CC BY 3.0)

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenBible.info ancient-place id; join with its Bible Geocoding Data. One place OpenBible.info files under another has our own id: cp-seba (Seba, filed under Sheba, a81ab85).

fields.name: name_en
fields.description: Name in English, as the Berean Standard Bible prints it.

fields.name: name_ar
fields.description: Name in Arabic, as the Van Dyck Bible (1865) prints it. Empty where that Bible does not print the name.

fields.name: name_de
fields.description: Name in German, as the Lutherbibel 1912 prints it. Empty where that Bible does not print the name.

fields.name: name_es
fields.description: Name in Spanish, as the Reina-Valera 1909 prints it. Empty where that Bible does not print the name.

fields.name: name_fr
fields.description: Name in French, as the Louis Segond 1910 prints it. Empty where that Bible does not print the name.

fields.name: name_it
fields.description: Name in Italian, as the Riveduta 1927 prints it. Empty where that Bible does not print the name.

fields.name: name_nl
fields.description: Name in Dutch, as the De Heilige Schrift 1917 prints it. Empty where that Bible does not print the name.

fields.name: name_pt
fields.description: Name in Portuguese, as the Bíblia Livre (CC BY 4.0) prints it. Empty where that Bible does not print the name.

fields.name: name_ru
fields.description: Name in Russian, as the Synodal translation prints it. Empty where that Bible does not print the name.

fields.name: name_zh
fields.description: Name in Chinese, as the Chinese Union Version prints it. Empty where that Bible does not print the name.

fields.name: name_ja
fields.description: Name in Japanese, as the Colloquial Japanese Bible (1955) prints it. Empty where that Bible does not print the name.

fields.name: name_kjv
fields.description: Name as the King James Version prints it, where it differs or for reference.

fields.name: lat
fields.description: Latitude of the point, WGS 84 (OpenBible.info; ours for cp-seba).

fields.name: lon
fields.description: Longitude of the point, WGS 84 (OpenBible.info; ours for cp-seba).

fields.name: label_lat
fields.description: For a region: latitude where the map prints its name. Empty for other places.

fields.name: label_lon
fields.description: For a region: longitude where the map prints its name. Empty for other places.

fields.name: site_today
fields.description: The modern place or site the point stands for.

fields.name: openbible_score
fields.description: OpenBible.info confidence in the identification (its time-weighted score, time_total): read it as thousandths, where 1000 is very high confidence. It is a trend line, so a few run below 0 or above 1000. Empty for cp-seba, which OpenBible.info does not list.

fields.name: certainty
fields.description: Our reading of how sure the location is: sure, likely, unsure, or region (an area, not a point).

fields.name: certainty_note
fields.description: One sentence on why, as the map shows it.

fields.name: other_proposed_sites
fields.description: Other sites proposed for it, separated by "; ".

fields.name: sources_surveyed
fields.description: Reference works OpenBible.info surveyed for this place (0 for cp-seba).

fields.name: verses
fields.description: Every verse in the Bible that names it, in English verse numbering, OSIS references separated by "; ".

fields.name: books
fields.description: The books of the Bible that name it, in Bible order, OSIS codes separated by "; ".

fields.name: pleiades
fields.description: Pleiades gazetteer page, where one matches.

fields.name: wikidata
fields.description: Wikidata item, where one matches.

fields.name: openbible_url
fields.description: The place on OpenBible.info (for cp-seba, the Sheba page it is filed under).

fields.name: pauls_journeys
fields.description: Where Paul stops here on our Paul map: journey_id:stop_order pairs, separated by "; ", matching pauls-journeys/stops.csv.

resources.name: places-geojson
resources.title: Places as GeoJSON
resources.description: The same places as GeoJSON points (WGS 84), with the names, certainty and verses as properties.
